verdict.rationale: TaxJar's API lets users pull transaction and rate data programmatically (JSON, an open format) via documented endpoints, which could be used to extract data, but there is no documented bulk 'export all my data' feature, no data-portability statement, and no llms.txt/OpenAPI spec was found (both probed and returned 404). missing for 10: dedicated full-account data export/dump feature, explicit data-portability policy, machine-readable API spec (openapi.json/llms.txt) for AI-native retrieval.
